Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date-HB" /> a '''conference on Aviles Prime''' took place on the<ref name="Tales" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC-Aviles">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Aviles Prime system/Legends|Aviles Prime system]]</ref> astronomical object [[Aviles Prime]].<ref name="Tales" /> [[Director General]] [[Lorca Oviedo]] of [[Oviedo Engineering]],<ref name="Tales" /> a military [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]] manufacturer,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|432|Oviedo Engineering}}</ref> attended the conference. After the event, he was to travel to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]]<ref name="Tales" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC-Coruscant">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Coruscant system]]</ref> [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Coruscant">{{DB|location|coruscant|Coruscant}}</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]; however, while his [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] and his [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] escorts traveled to Coruscant, they exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and were subsequently [[Action on Asturias|shot down]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces, crashing on the<ref name="Tales" /> Expansion Region<ref name="EAOC-Asturias">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Asturias system/Legends|Asturias system]]</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Asturias]].<ref name="Tales" />

==Behind the scenes==
The conference on Aviles Prime was mentioned in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story "[[Honor Bound]]," which was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Tales" /> on [[February 23]], [[2005]]<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54000/star_wars_tales_1999_22|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) #22}}</ref> as part of the [[Star Wars Tales 22|twenty-second]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' comic-book series. The story was written by [[Ian Edginton]] and illustrated by [[Steve Pugh]].<ref name="Tales" />
